literal_meaning: ভূতকে তাড়ানো বা ভাগানো (chasing away or expelling a ghost)
figurative_meaning_en: To correct or reform character flaws or bad habits
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অলসতার ভূত তাড়ানোর জন্য কঠোর পরিশ্রম করতে হবে।
সে তার ক্রোধের ভূত তাড়িয়ে একজন শান্ত মানুষ হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He needs to chase away the ghost of his laziness through hard work.
She has exorcised the demon of her anger and become a calmer person.
history: Rooted in Bengali folklore and traditional exorcism rituals involving tantra and shamanistic practices to remove evil spirits.
note: The idiom draws from widespread beliefs in ghosts (bhoot) in Bengali culture, often linked to personal misfortunes.
